errors.quote: Each edge factor is a translate $aI+bX_v$ of [Two-point kernel C](phase-kernel.md), one per basis vector.
errors.problem: Right after showing that \varepsilon=-1 gives the inverse bI+aX_v, this sentence says every edge factor is aI+bX_v. The paper has "aI+bX_v, or its inverse". Calling it a "translate" of C is also loose: it is the kernel C acting along the direction v.
